title: Steps to manage regular term deposit

steps.text: Login to mobile application,Land on deposits dashboard
Select “Regular Term Deposit” type , Click on 'manage deposit' button
Select  the interest payout account ,the payout after maturity account.
Manage auto renewal (On / Off). If turned on, select either 'Renew principal amount only' or 'Renew principal amount and credit interest'. , then Confirm the 'Terms and conditions' and Click 'Save'
